Count-indicator parameters of a mixture model

countparams.Rd

Class-specific parameters of the count indicators of a mixture() model, on the natural scale.

Usage

countparams(object)

Arguments

object

A model fitted by mixture() with at least one count indicator.

Value

A data frame with one row per count indicator and class: item, model ("poisson", "negbin", "zip"), class, mean (E(y | class): the rate for Poisson, mu for the negative binomial, (1 - pi) lambda for the zero-inflated Poisson), rate (lambda), dispersion (negative binomial alpha; 0 otherwise) and inflation (zero-inflation probability pi; 0 otherwise). Standard errors (of the log means, dispersions and inflation logits): parameters().

See also

mixture(), parameters()

Examples

data(aces)
# \donttest{
m <- mixture(aces, K = 4, categorical = starts_with("ace_"), negbin = depress)
#> Starting Julia ...
countparams(m)
#>      item  model class       mean       rate dispersion inflation
#> 1 depress negbin     1  5.6586580  5.6586580 0.05346245         0
#> 2 depress negbin     2 11.5186493 11.5186493 0.05346245         0
#> 3 depress negbin     3  7.3331555  7.3331555 0.05346245         0
#> 4 depress negbin     4  0.3164328  0.3164328 0.05346245         0
# }
